nodes.label: Skeleton conformance checklist
nodes.rationale: Manual checks for lockfile, MIT, docs links, CI names and issue template until MT-01 ships a script.

nodes.label: Factory conventions as a product
nodes.rationale: The repo is the source of truth for ticket, CI, label and docs conventions that product repos copy.

nodes.label: MT-STOP — stop ticket
nodes.rationale: A permanently red verifier ticket; if it goes green, stop the factory and fix the verifier.

nodes.label: Never infer a product decision
nodes.rationale: UNKNOWN items become needs-amit issues; rules change only by PR to HARD_RULES.md.

nodes.label: needs-amit UNKNOWN queue
nodes.rationale: Anything not covered by Week-0 v2, Session B or Amit references becomes a needs-amit issue instead of a guess.

nodes.label: COPY — copy the template into a product
nodes.norm_label: copy — copy the template into a product

nodes.label: docs/contracts — one API contract per batch
nodes.norm_label: docs/contracts — one api contract per batch

nodes.label: Council AI memory system plan
nodes.rationale: Plan to port a Lovable memory system into Expo + Convex with sectors, salience, decay and chat.

nodes.label: Payments split: Polar (web) / RevenueCat (mobile)
nodes.rationale: RevenueCat is the source of truth for mobile subscriptions; no Polar Convex stubs may be invented.

nodes.label: Flow A — builder makes a new app
nodes.norm_label: flow a — builder makes a new app
nodes.rationale: From Use this template to a live preview: install, keys from 1Password, Convex deploy, Vercel link, first PR.

nodes.label: Flow B — web end user
nodes.rationale: Landing, sign-in modals, signed-in pages, paywall modal and Polar checkout.

nodes.label: users table
nodes.rationale: Convex Auth tables plus one users table with email, role, userType and active flags.

nodes.label: Mobile-only Convex modules stay flagged
nodes.rationale: conversations, memories and messages came from the mobile template and must not be silently merged into the shared schema.

nodes.label: Missing package slots
nodes.rationale: packages/core, packages/ui and packages/config are intended but absent; create them only from a ticket.

nodes.label: One shared Convex deployment
nodes.rationale: Web and mobile must point NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL at the same deployment.

nodes.label: Council AI assistant mobile integration plan
nodes.norm_label: council ai assistant mobile integration plan

nodes.label: Accessibility floor
nodes.rationale: Short labels, 44px targets, WCAG AA contrast, visible focus and words for every status; Amit is dyslexic.

nodes.label: Theme tokens (Tailwind v4 @theme)
nodes.rationale: zinc-grey tokens drive light and dark mode from prefers-color-scheme; apps swap tokens rather than components.

nodes.label: Template bootstrap steps
nodes.rationale: Use this template, create integration, pnpm install and pnpm run setup, then link Vercel and Expo.

nodes.label: Understand Anything artefact
nodes.rationale: .ua/knowledge-graph.json holds the dashboard graph; regenerate after layout changes and open a draft PR.

nodes.label: Committed Graphify artefact
nodes.rationale: docs/graphs/monorepo-template.json was generated with graphifyy 0.9.74 (1110 nodes, 1411 edges).

nodes.label: OmniAgent multi-app amendment
nodes.rationale: Four apps (spice-web, spice-mobile, work-web, work-mobile) share one packages/backend in the omniagent repo, not here.

nodes.label: Graphify code map slot
nodes.rationale: Graphify (graphifyy) fills slot C-3 with a committed snapshot and graph query commands.

nodes.label: Factory report format
nodes.rationale: status, ticket, evidence, changed, unknowns and notes for ticket sync posted on the ticket.

nodes.label: Three attempts per ticket
nodes.rationale: Checks or review failing three times makes a ticket stuck; do not widen scope to force a pass.

nodes.label: Ticket — eleven fields
nodes.rationale: FOR, WHEN, WHY, GOAL, SCOPE, MUTATES, STEPS, DONE, EVIDENCE, DO NOT, REPORT; SCOPE is at most 3 files plus 1 test.

nodes.label: FACTORY_PAUSED=true
nodes.rationale: The build loop does not run until Phase L; only rule files may be configured.

nodes.label: Tool slot registry
nodes.rationale: Every factory tool is a slot filled in factory/SLOTS.md; other files do not name tools.

nodes.label: Secrets: names only
nodes.rationale: Never commit, print or log a secret value; values come from the 1Password dev vault via a service account.

nodes.label: Live secret intake (names only)
nodes.rationale: One key per tool after the 24 Aug 2026 rotation, Convex two-key exception; retired keys are removed, not rotated.

nodes.label: PROVIDERS — provider seams and secret names
nodes.norm_label: providers — provider seams and secret names

nodes.label: Locked CI check names
nodes.rationale: Six job names stay in lockstep with tempo-rhythm so branch rules work across repos; renaming is path drift.

nodes.label: Rule 1.4 — merge into integration
nodes.rationale: Auto-merge is off; a PR merges into integration only with green required checks, Greptile passing, no conflicts and files inside MUTATES.

nodes.label: Reference precedence order
nodes.rationale: Amit decisions, then Basic Memory merge policy, then factory-v2, factory kit and Ras Mic skills; marked rules are overruled.

nodes.label: Bun-only package manager target
nodes.rationale: Amit decided on 3 Oct 2026 that Bun is the only package manager; the repo still uses pnpm, a known mismatch M1.

nodes.label: One-day preview goal
nodes.rationale: A new app built from the template should reach a live preview in one working day with 1-2 adjustments.

nodes.label: Phase 0 — factory gates
nodes.rationale: Org move, docs and wiki, and 11-field tickets with Graphify context must land before automations turn on.

nodes.label: Phase 5 — Bolt graft
nodes.rationale: The template acceptance test is a Bolt export landing in apps/* with zero backend edits.

nodes.label: Bun switch scope
nodes.rationale: The Bun migration touches package.json, lockfiles, docs, CI install steps and the repo description, guarded by config-guard.

nodes.label: No second authority
nodes.rationale: The factory exists so agents ship without inventing a second layout, CI contract or queue.

nodes.label: Flow B — mobile end user
nodes.rationale: Expo auth stack, authenticated tabs, settings and RevenueCat paywall.

nodes.label: Missing owner checks in users.ts
nodes.rationale: getById, listActive, updateProfile, remove and updateUserType lack owner checks; each needs a code ticket before going live.

nodes.label: Magic-link sign-in target
nodes.rationale: Target sign-in is a Resend magic link through Convex Auth, replacing password-only sign-in (ticket M-AUTH).
